headline: Web platforms and pipelines scale microbial comparative genomics and meta-omics analysis
label: Microbial Comparative Genomics Platforms
summary: Database releases from OMA, MGnify and Unipept arrive alongside new web apps and Nextflow pipelines that package microbial and comparative analyses.
synthesis: The dominant thread is the consolidation of comparative genomics and microbiome analyses into maintained web platforms and workflow-managed pipelines. Major resource updates lead. OMA 2027 covers 2983 extant and 1226 ancestral genomes and adds structure-aware orthology using 3Di and structural alignments, plus FastOMA and OrthoXML tooling. MGnify v6 adds amplicon variant analysis, expanded viral and mobilome annotation, and Nextflow/Prefect automation. Unipept now supports multi-sample metaproteomics comparison with confidence scoring and a lower-memory API. Several smaller tools target specific steps. nf-core/pairgenomealign wraps LAST whole-genome alignment in Nextflow. ABAQS scores annotation quality and has been applied to more than 1700 fungal genomes. Big Tree Viewer renders trees of up to a million tips in the browser. MolEvolvR characterizes proteins through domain architecture and phylogeny. For 16S data, RADSuite and VPHYL address species-level identification and nanopore table conversion into phyloseq or BIOM objects. The summaries report no cross-tool benchmarks.
